character.description: young Taiwanese adult, short black hair, grey T-shirt, olive knee shorts, blue-and-white flip-flops, black crossbody bag

jog_up.action: light relaxed JOG moving AWAY from the viewer, seen from BEHIND in a high three-quarter game camera, a smooth continuous 8-phase run cycle in place, evenly spaced phases in order: left contact, left down, left push-off, airborne, right contact, right down, right push-off, airborne. The trailing heel kicks up showing the sole, elbows bent about 90 degrees and swinging opposite to the legs, torso leans slightly forward, the whole body rises in the airborne phases, bag swings

jog_side.action: light relaxed JOG toward screen RIGHT, full side profile facing right, a smooth continuous 8-phase run cycle in place, evenly spaced phases in order: contact, down, passing, airborne, then the same four with the other leg forward. Knees lift, back heel kicks up, elbows bent and swinging opposite to legs, slight forward lean, bag bounces

jog_down.action: light relaxed JOG TOWARD the viewer, front view in a high three-quarter game camera, a smooth continuous 8-phase run cycle in place with clearly alternating left and right knee lifts, bent elbows pumping opposite to the legs, bag bouncing, calm slightly hurried face
